FN-IAI7666-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 25
Committee: Tourism Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 25 as introduced would require grants awarded from sales taxes collected on the sale
of alcoholic beverages within a community development district be distributed based on the
recommendation of each legislator representing a portion of the county. This bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
